Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nets.

Bottom line: the Pelicans win 63 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.

analyst.text: New Orleans are coming off a 51-point loss at Golden State, the worst regular-season defeat in franchise history, with four technicals. Coach Jamahl Mosley was graded an F. Brooklyn were routed by 37 in Dallas. Noah Clowney shoved an opponent there, and Michael Porter Jr. remains on the trade block in a contract year. Both teams are fragile; the Pelicans have more to prove after a humiliation, a mild lean their way if Zion Williamson returns from rest.
